name: api.mac.texas2010.com
description: This is a personal API built specifically for macOS integration. It powers custom Apple Shortcuts, handles background tasks, and serves as a communication layer between my Mac and various automations. Designed to give me full control over system-level workflows with minimal setup.

scripts.caddy:restart: echo 'Only run this if you changed the Caddyfile!' && brew services restart caddy
scripts.test: npm run build:ts && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && FASTIFY_AUTOLOAD_TYPESCRIPT=1 node --test --experimental-test-coverage --loader ts-node/esm test/**/*.ts
scripts.start: npm run build:ts && fastify start -l info dist/app.js | pino-pretty
scripts.check:pm2: pm2 -v || (echo '❌ PM2 is required. Install with: npm install -g pm2' && exit 1)
scripts.pm2:dev:start: npm run check:pm2 && pm2 start ecosystem.config.json --only api-mac.dev.texas2010.com
scripts.pm2:dev:reload: npm run check:pm2 && pm2 reload ecosystem.config.json --only api-mac.dev.texas2010.com --update-env
scripts.pm2:dev:stop: npm run check:pm2 && pm2 stop api-mac.dev.texas2010.com
scripts.pm2:dev:restart: npm run check:pm2 && pm2 restart api-mac.dev.texas2010.com
scripts.pm2:prod:start: npm run check:pm2 && pm2 start ecosystem.config.json --only api.mac.texas2010.com
scripts.pm2:prod:reload: npm run check:pm2 && pm2 reload ecosystem.config.json --only api.mac.texas2010.com --update-env
scripts.pm2:prod:stop: npm run check:pm2 && pm2 stop api.mac.texas2010.com
scripts.pm2:prod:restart: npm run check:pm2 && pm2 restart api.mac.texas2010.com

author: texas2010
